metadata.description: Semantic code search and architecture understanding for LingoLinq-AAC

Development PostgreSQL access, scoped to this repo only. Read-only: every query runs inside BEGIN TRANSACTION READ ONLY and is rolled back (verified 2026-07-01 against the actual installed package, dist/index.js) -- it cannot write or run DDL. NOTE: this npm package is marked deprecated/no-longer-supported upstream; treat as a candidate for replacement, not a long-term dependency. Before approving on first load, self-verify YOUR OWN local `lingolinq-development` DB holds no real student/patient rows -- Scot confirmed his was synthetic-only on 2026-06-14, but that confirmation is per-machine and does not carry over to any other checkout or clone. Read-only access to real rows would still be a FERPA/HIPAA exposure even without write risk; if your local DB is ever seeded from prod, do not approve it.
